## Quality Checklist

### For New Prompts
- [ ] Follows naming convention: `{category}_{function}.md`
- [ ] Includes clear objective statement
- [ ] Has structured instructions
- [ ] Specifies expected output format
- [ ] Includes worked examples (if applicable)
- [ ] Has "DO NOT" / false-positive prevention section (for Tier 4)
- [ ] Placed in correct domain directory

### For New Skills/Agents/Commands
- [ ] Has valid YAML frontmatter
- [ ] Follows directory structure conventions
- [ ] Includes usage examples
- [ ] Has bundled resources (if applicable)

### For All Changes
- [ ] No broken links introduced
- [ ] README.md updated if counts changed
- [ ] Tested with target AI model (if applicable)
